open_points.subject: A3 rule 7 and R0-10 — replacement with previously placed content
open_points.text: “A file replaced with other content is a new photo and waits for the owner's delivery.” / “A replaced source is a new photo unless its content already has a placement, which then answers under rule 2.”
open_points.question: When a file is replaced by content that already has a placement in the same project, is it a new photo waiting for delivery, or the existing photo whose delivery answers REPLAYED?
options: Treat every replacement with different content as a new photo waiting for a new placement, as R0-10 says.
Use project-and-content identity: report the existing placement and answer REPLAYED, as A3 rules 1, 2 and 7 say.
open_points.default_guess: Use project-and-content identity and answer REPLAYED, treating A3 as the refinement of R0-10.

witness.initial: Project P has a placement for content B. A different file x.jpg currently contains placed content A.
events: Syncthing replaces x.jpg with content B.
The calling flow scans project P and asks to deliver x.jpg with B's source id.
outcomes: Under R0-10, x.jpg is a new photo after replacement and waits for a new delivery.
Under A3 rules 1, 2 and 7, the scan reports the existing placement for B and delivery answers REPLAYED without writing.
witness.observer: The owner and calling flow see whether x.jpg is offered as a new photo and whether delivery reports a new placement or a replay.
